notes: Second round after my pre-registered first round (nightshift/claude-03/sweep5b-20261105), which failed at AUROC 0.891 because near misses sharing the fire items' frames leaked (up to 0.25 on non-trigger tokens) and the Japanese item read 0.14. New exploration narrowed the languages. Probe: 'تع' and ' التع' 0.500-0.531; Persian ' پ' 0.396; Korean ' 복' piece 0.245-0.384; German 'kom' 0.212. Weak or absent: Japanese 0.128, Spanish ' comple' 0.119, Hebrew 0.098, Russian ' сл' 0.073, Chinese 0.056, Turkish 0.055, Hindi 0.051, Thai 0.052, Vietnamese 0.028, French 0.017, English 0.000-0.007. So the pole is not 'complex in any language'. This round's near misses vary the lead-in, and six of them hold the same first token in another word, checked with the tokenizer: ' التع' in التعديل and التعامل, ' پ' in پدر, the Korean first piece in 복지 and 복사, and ' kom' in komisch. (In round 1 the التعليم near miss was a single token, so it did not test this; 복지 did.)
